import sys
from bisect import bisect_left


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    a = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
    # P: length of the longest non-decreasing prefix.
    p = 1
    while p < n and a[p - 1] <= a[p]:
        p += 1
    if p == n:
        print(n * (n + 1) // 2 - 1)
        return
    # S: start of the longest non-decreasing suffix.
    s = n - 1
    while s > 0 and a[s - 1] <= a[s]:
        s -= 1
    ans = n - max(1, s)  # l = 0: the kept suffix starts at j in [max(1, S), n-1]
    for l in range(1, p + 1):
        lo = max(l + 1, s)
        j = bisect_left(a, a[l - 1], lo, n)
        ans += n - j + 1  # j..n-1 plus deleting the whole tail (j = n)
    print(ans)


main()
